item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 22/Apr/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will continue to bring hot weather to the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. There will also be one or two showers over the region. With the anticyclone aloft covering the northern part of the South China Sea weakening and a trough of low pressure developing gradually over southern China, there will be showers and thunderstorms over Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week. A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong over the weekend. Temperatures will fall slightly over the region.
